# Imports
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

```

# Load data
```{r}

train_data = read.csv("Train_dataset.csv")
test_data = read.csv("Test_dataset.csv")

```

# Train dataset
```{r}

summary(train_data$evenements_hepatiques_majeurs)
summary(train_data$death)

```

## Output Class distribution
```{r}

counts1 <- table(train_data$evenements_hepatiques_majeurs)

barplot(
  counts,
  main = "Class distribution",
  xlab = "Evenements Hepatiques Majeurs",
  ylab = "Count"
)

counts2 <- table(train_data$death)

barplot(
  counts,
  main = "Class distribution",
  xlab = "Death",
  ylab = "Count"
)

```

## Evolving features
### Identify all evolving features
```{r}

v_cols <- grep("_v[0-9]+$", names(train_data), value = TRUE)

base_features <- v_cols %>%
  str_remove("_v[0-9]+$") %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()

base_features
length(base_features)

```

### Reshape evolving features into long data
```{r}

long_data <- train_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("_v[0-9]+$"),
    names_to = c("feature", "visit"),
    names_pattern = "^(.*)_v([0-9]+)$",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(visit = as.integer(visit))

```

### Summarize evolution into a table
```{r}

feature_summary <- long_data %>%
  group_by(feature, visit) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = sum(!is.na(value)),
    missing_rate = mean(is.na(value)),
    mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_value = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(feature_summary)

```

### Plot the features
```{r}

ggplot(feature_summary, aes(x = visit, y = mean_value)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ feature, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Mean trajectories over visits",
    x = "Visit",
    y = "Mean value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

### Compare trajectories by outcome
#### Evenement Hepatiques Majeurs
```{r}

feature_by_outcome <- long_data %>%
  group_by(feature, visit, evenements_hepatiques_majeurs) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_obs = sum(!is.na(value)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(feature_by_outcome, aes(x = visit, y = mean_value, color = as.factor(evenements_hepatiques_majeurs))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ feature, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Feature trajectories by outcome",
    x = "Visit",
    y = "Mean value",
    color = "evenements_hepatiques_majeurs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

#### Death
```{r}

feature_by_outcome <- long_data %>%
  group_by(feature, visit, death) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_obs = sum(!is.na(value)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(feature_by_outcome, aes(x = visit, y = mean_value, color = as.factor(death))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ feature, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Feature trajectories by outcome",
    x = "Visit",
    y = "Mean value",
    color = "death"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
